# WeatherXM Firmware Flasher

> Browser-based firmware tools for WeatherXM WG1200 gateways and WS1300 weather stations.

## Canonical site
- https://flasher.weatherxm.com/

## Device flows
- WG1200 USB firmware flasher: https://flasher.weatherxm.com/wg1200
- WS1300 Bluetooth firmware updater: https://flasher.weatherxm.com/ws1300/

## Related resources
- WeatherXM stations: https://weatherxm.com/stations/
- WeatherXM Open Technology: https://weatherxm.com/open/
- WeatherXM documentation: https://docs.weatherxm.com/
- WeatherXM GitHub: https://github.com/WeatherXM

## Notes
- WG1200 firmware can be switched between supported WeatherXM and Meshtastic modes using the browser tool.
- WS1300 firmware can be updated over Bluetooth from a compatible browser.
- The development-only WS1300 route is intentionally excluded from indexing.
